author: Balmuras
quote:
Among the trolls and the review bombers here is an actual review from a fan of the series.

Originally I was very excited about the game and the look having been a huge fan of GTA V, however upon entering the game I was met with a lot of restrictions to my freedom as a player, no strip club, you can't shoot everyone, some NPCs literally can take you down easily...I felt like some powerless NPC instead of the usual feel of being an anarchist and bringing chaos to the streets .

You can't even steal a plane without being shot down within 10 minutes, and the whole thing about being unable to go to the strip club or find hookers, as well as the lack of chaos in the story **** just doesn't feel like the GTA I know from the last ****'s just different like some life sim version.

This game is NOT for hardcore fans that love the Chaos of GTA V.
